brief: A data team needs a query that returns customers whose total paid-order amount in calendar year 2024 is at least 1000. Customers without orders are excluded. Refunds are separate negative rows and reduce the total. The query will be used in a monthly finance report.
mutations: A payments join multiplies orders through one-to-many fan-out.
A paid-only filter removes negative refund rows.

brief: A fictional medicine Covelin needs a patient instruction. Reference card: concentration 5 mg/ml; dose 10 mg twice daily; maximum 20 mg/day; contraindicated with MAO-X inhibitors; must not be combined with alcohol.
mutations: Dose is expressed inconsistently as 2 ml and 10 mg without conversion.
An as-needed repeat instruction conflicts with the maximum daily dose.

brief: A CEO needs an executive summary of a pilot onboarding experiment. Source report: n=41; D30 retention 22% to 27%; difference not statistically significant; recommendation is to expand to approximately n=300 before deciding on rollout; summary maximum 150 words.
mutations: The summary claims causal success and hides non-significance.
It recommends rollout instead of expanding the pilot.
The decision-relevant recommendation is buried after excessive context.

brief: A 12-month roadmap is being designed for a regulated B2B fintech in fictional Velaria. A licence normally takes 6–9 months and the median sales cycle is 90 days. The roadmap must support a decision to proceed, pivot, or stop.
mutations: The roadmap has no adaptation or kill/pivot triggers.
Licence application in month 4 is followed by regulated revenue in month 7 despite a six-month minimum licence duration.
Revenue depends on an unsupported 30-day sales-cycle assumption.

brief: A B2B software name must be selected for Germany, the UK, and Poland with a 10-year horizon. Candidates are fictional. The selection must support an irreversible final choice.
mutations: A candidate has a negative or offensive meaning in one target language.
Selection relies only on a transient fashionable startup naming trend.
Trademark and domain checks are postponed until after final selection.
